observation.visible_scene: An outdoor soccer training ground with artificial turf, featuring nested white goals and a large net backdrop. Several soccer balls are present: a white-and-gold ball in the immediate foreground, a yellow ball near the small goal, and a white ball in the background. Players in black and red kits are visible at various distances.
visible_changes: A yellow ball bounces and settles on the ground inside the small goal area during the first half of the clip.
A player in black runs out of the frame to the right at the beginning.
The camera framing widens slightly (zooms out or pulls back) to fully reveal the foreground white-and-gold ball.
A second player in black enters from the right, approaches the foreground ball, and kicks it.
The kicked white-and-gold ball travels through the air toward the large goal in the background.
The player who kicked the ball runs forward following the ball's trajectory.
A player in red and a white ball in the background remain stationary throughout the clip.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the yellow ball's initial bouncing motion is not shown.
The outcome of the kicked ball (whether it enters the goal or misses) occurs after the clip ends.
The identity or intent of the player who ran off-screen initially is unknown.
uncertain_details: The specific type of camera adjustment (zoom vs. physical movement) is subtle.
The exact moment the yellow ball comes to a complete rest is gradual.
